Under legacy semantics, `"auto"` resolves to `"multiindex"`, so all specified option settings make `flat` false. `create_model` still obtains `sns` through the unchanged `as_index(n, snapshots, "snapshots")` call and passes that same `sns` to the variable and constraint builders; the new context does not flatten snapshots when `flat` is false. Changes inside builders do not change which snapshots `create_model` hands them.
